# Tarmic Pharma Pvt. Ltd.

> Branded pharmaceutical tablets and capsules: anti-diabetic, anti-hypertensive, neuropathy, musculoskeletal, statins / anti-platelets, antacid and other formulations. Each product page lists composition, packing and MRP per strip. Contact: operations@tarmic.in
